system_b.sql_query:
SELECT category,
       SUM(current_price_paise) / 100.0 AS average_price_rupees
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

system_c.sql_query:
SELECT category,
       AVG(current_price_paise) / 100.0 AS average_price_rupees
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
